sourceTrack: Click Track (stem 23348806), public preview, user-confirmed timbre
sourceFormat: AAC, stereo, 44100 Hz; this is a preview excerpt, not an original lossless master
processing: ffmpeg AAC decode to stereo PCM16 at original 44100 Hz, then sample-exact contiguous single-click cuts. No normalization, filtering, synthesis, pitch shift, time stretch, channel mixing or fade. Near-silent boundaries (at most two PCM16 units) retain pre-ringing and the decay through the quantization noise floor. Only runtime beat gain changes.
mapping: The reference alternates these higher/lower clicks. The metronome uses the higher click for strong whole beats and lower click for other beats/subdivisions; rhythm remains controlled by each song setting.

files.role: lower click for ordinary beats and subdivisions
